title: 23美元蜜瓜特调：年销超50万杯，成本不到3美元，为何仍抢手？

segments.en: Are you going to be going to the U.S. Open? I wish I could, but I can't afford to eat there and that.

segments.zh: 其实就是伏特加、柠檬水，加三颗蜜瓜球。

segments.en: And it looks good, but that's not the only thing, okay?
segments.zh: 看起来不错，但这还不是全部。

segments.en: So that one's been going. You have Taylor Swift holding them.
segments.zh: 这款特调一直很火，泰勒·斯威夫特都拿着它。

segments.en: That's Tom's friend, you know, just going out and taking pictures with them.

segments.en: All these celebrities, Bruce Springsteen, then they had the merch to go with it.
segments.zh: 还有布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀等名人，他们还有配套的周边商品。

segments.en: So you can't just get the merch. You got to get the towel. It's going to t-shirt.
